notes.title: Update 1.6.1
notes.content:
A new update is available!
You are now able to gain bonus points at the end of every level.
For every setting you turn off and for the AI difficulty, you'll get a higher points multiplier.
We have redesigned the menu table. We replaced the static flat images with 3D objects such as a gear for settings or a map for maps. You are now able to interact with these objects, for example you can grab them and throw them away.
In addition to that, we added new settings, start position on the map previews and a new achievement.
And many more changes!

- Added setting for AI difficulty
- Added setting for AI position markers
- Added setting for aiming assistance
- Added bonus points for player at the end of a level
- Added achievement for the bonus points multiplier
- Added new objects in menu for maps, tanks and settings, even the left and right arrow is now an object
- Added interaction with the tank in the tank tab
- Added AI start positions on all map preview images
- Fixed AI is getting stuck in front off trees
- Fixed level not ending
- Fixed distortion on visor inside the tank

notes.title: Update 1.6.0
notes.content:
The Update 1.6.0 is out!

TankVR got a new menu with some interactions.
In front of you is a table, where you can select a map, a tank or change the settings.
In the middle of the table is a big screen, where you can see your selected map, tank or game settings. To scroll threw the pages, there are buttons on theex left and right.
To activate a button, you have to touch it and press the trigger to let things happen.

- Added new game menu
- Added settings to configure the game's difficulty
- Fixed player was not able to controll the tank
- Fixed game was not finished after destroying all hostile tanks
